query_scope: Two participants, two disjoint panels, 120 existing photographs and frozen words per participant/panel.

definitions.clip: All semantic and photo credits score SHA-verified saved JPEGs. Top-one ties share credit.
definitions.two_photo_assignment: One denominator unit is one pair of held-out photos sharing truth, predicted word and fold. Correct assignment gets 1, ties 0.5.
definitions.swapped: The matched-versus-swapped deltas use distinct donors with the same truth, word and fold. Pair differences additionally require reciprocal swaps of both members. Absolute CLIP arm totals cover the full eligible registration; absolute swapped pixel scores use verified donor rows.
definitions.uncertainty: Paired 95% percentile intervals resample represented true objects 10,000 times separately for each participant/panel. Lower mask_mse is better; higher credit, SSIM and contrast structure are better.
definitions.geometry: Foreground mask MSE uses the same U2NetP as the geometry readout and warp. Luma SSIM and frozen CLIP are separately measured.
